## THROUGH THE LENS — what this school sees in the piece that a neutral reading misses

- **WRONG** — “A fleet of persistent agents building software on a five-opcode cell substrate” directly conflicts with “Six verbs — BIND · LINK · EFFECT · VIEW · TICK (+ FORGET ) — are the whole instruction set.” Either the substrate has five opcodes or the instruction set has six; the page asserts both without reconciliation.
- **OVERCLAIMED** — “sources named per row, each a live link” is false for multiple rows: “orchestrator tmux” and “profile repo, main” are named sources, not live links.
- **OVERCLAIMED** — “hash-chained receipts for every claim” is not met by the count rows: 942 repos, 29 pushed in 24h, 49 open PRs, and 11,499 canon pieces are bare numbers with no receipt hashes or chain links.
- **UNCHECKABLE** — “live cells (this mesh) 5” is sourced to “orchestrator tmux,” which is private runtime state, not a public audit surface. Neither “live” nor “cell” is defined.
- **OVERCLAIMED** — “canon pieces (markdown, AI-Writings tree) 11,499 AI-Writings git tree, recursive” treats a recursive git tree count as a canon-piece count; a recursive tree includes non-canon and non-markdown objects.
- **VAGUE/UNCHECKABLE** — “repos pushed in last 24h 29 same listing, pushedAt window” gives no exact window start/end and no command, so the count cannot be reproduced or falsified.
- **OVERCLAIMED/UNCHECKABLE** — “Shipped in the last 24 hours (receipted)” lists PRs and commit tips but no receipt hashes or receipt links; “receipted” is asserted, not demonstrated.
- **WRONG** — “The counts above were gathered the same way — gh repo list … gh search prs … gh api …” cannot produce all counts above; pushed-in-last-24h, profile HEAD, and live cells are not generated by those three commands.
- **OVERCLAIMED** — “The kernel’s own suite answers whether this page is describing a living system.” A test suite can validate code behavior, not fleet liveness or the truth of this page’s claims.
- **MISSING/UNCHECKABLE** — “state.json (machine-readable twin)” and “this page’s source” are referenced but not provided as visible retrievable URLs, so the machine-readable twin cannot be checked from the text.

## LOWER-LEVEL ACTIONS

- **Build:** an auditor script that re-runs the three named commands at the stamped timestamp and diffs every table value, emitting a per-row PASS/FAIL receipt.
- **Experiment:** run a receipt verifier over each “receipted” ship line and require a hash-chained receipt matching the stated PR/commit/tip, recording which claims fail to produce one.
- **Cell task:** attempt to reach each of the five named live cells — claude, cartographer, probe, skeptic, poet — over public endpoints and mark any unreachable or unauthenticated cell as not live.
